verdict.rationale: Snowflake ships agentic features (Cortex Agents, Cortex Code), so asking whether it can act as an MCP client is fair. However, the pack only documents a Snowflake-managed MCP server that exposes Snowflake tools to outside agents. That is the server role and does not show Snowflake connecting to external MCP servers to use their tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
